decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable extension of the core thermoforming range, have their own page, and their market prospects are still uncertain only one year after launch, so the option is cheap to hold.
A PETG thermoforming blank fits squarely into the established materials portfolio for dental labs, costs little to carry, and is prominently presented, so keeping the option open is justified.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website, which suggests limited commitment, but as a cheap consumable with unresolved demand it is still worth keeping for now.
The intraoral contrast spray supports digital scanning workflows, which matches the firm's digital strategy, has its own page, and its uncertainty has not yet resolved.
The custom earmold line draws on the firm's core custom-device manufacturing skills for hearing-care retailers, so carrying costs are low relative to the remaining upside.
Custom hearing protection earmolds use existing earmold production capabilities and serve a growing protection market, and with little evidence of failure yet the option merits holding.
